DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of safekeeping expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for a place of safekeeping.
